about: Script lineage cases from an external audit of BigQuery scripting (variables, scopes, procedures, EXECUTE IMMEDIATE, conditions, loops, transactions, temporary tables). Expected writes and reads follow GoogleSQL semantics; kind says whether master got the case wrong (finding), right (control) or it marks a documented boundary.

cases.sql: DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a); DECLARE y INT64 DEFAULT x; CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT y AS v;
DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a); SELECT 1 AS v;
DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a); DECLARE y INT64; SET y=x; CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT y AS v;
DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a); SET x=(SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_b); CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT x AS v;
BEGIN DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a); END; CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT x.v FROM source_b x;
FOR x IN (SELECT v FROM source_a) DO SELECT 0; END FOR; CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT x.v FROM source_b x;

BEGIN DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a); CREATE TABLE first_dest AS SELECT x AS v; END; BEGIN DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_b); CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT x AS v; END;

DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a); DECLARE y INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_b); CREATE PROCEDURE f(x INT64) BEGIN SELECT x; END; CALL f(y); CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT x AS v;
DECLARE x INT64; CREATE PROCEDURE f(OUT val INT64) BEGIN SET val=(SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a); END; CALL f(x); CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT x AS v;
DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a); CREATE PROCEDURE f(INOUT val INT64) BEGIN SET val=(SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_b); END; CALL f(x); CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT x AS v;
DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a); EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT @x AS v' USING x AS x;
DECLARE x INT64; EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a' INTO x; CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT x AS v;
IF (SELECT MAX(v) FROM guard_source)>0 THEN CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT v FROM body_source; END IF;
WHILE (SELECT MAX(v) FROM guard_source)>0 DO CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT v FROM body_source; END WHILE;
CASE (SELECT MAX(v) FROM guard_source) WHEN 1 THEN CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT v FROM body_source; END CASE;
REPEAT CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT v FROM body_source; UNTIL (SELECT MAX(v) FROM guard_source)>0 END REPEAT;
DECLARE x INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a); DECLARE y INT64 DEFAULT 0; DECLARE n INT64 DEFAULT 0; WHILE n<2 DO CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dest AS SELECT y AS v; SET y=x; SET n=n+1; END WHILE;
IF RAND()>0.5 THEN CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT v FROM source_a; ELSE CREATE TABLE other_dest AS SELECT v FROM source_b; END IF;
CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT v FROM source_a; IF RAND()>0.5 THEN CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT v FROM source_b; END IF; SELECT v FROM t;
BEGIN SELECT v FROM source_a; EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT v FROM source_b; END;
RETURN; SELECT v FROM source_a;
DECLARE s STRING DEFAULT 'SELECT v FROM source_a'; EXECUTE IMMEDIATE s; SELECT 1 AS v;
CALL unknown_proc(); SELECT 1 AS v;
CREATE PROCEDURE f() BEGIN CALL missing(); END; CALL f(); SELECT 1 AS v;
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT v FROM source_a'; SELECT 1 AS v;
CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT v FROM source_a; CREATE TEMP TABLE u AS SELECT v FROM t; SELECT v FROM u;
CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT v FROM source_a; CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT v+1 AS v FROM t; SELECT v FROM t;
CREATE TEMP TABLE t(v INT64); INSERT INTO t SELECT v FROM source_a; SELECT v FROM t;
CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT v FROM source_a; DELETE FROM t WHERE v>0; SELECT v FROM t;
CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT v FROM source_a; TRUNCATE TABLE t; SELECT v FROM t;
CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT v FROM source_a; UPDATE t SET v=(SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_b) WHERE TRUE; SELECT v FROM t;
CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT v FROM source_a; MERGE t USING source_b b ON t.v=b.v WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET v=b.v; SELECT v FROM t;
CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT v FROM source_a; BEGIN TRANSACTION; INSERT INTO t SELECT v FROM source_b; ROLLBACK TRANSACTION; CREATE TABLE dest AS SELECT v FROM t;
INSERT INTO t SELECT v FROM source_a; SELECT v FROM t;
CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT v FROM source_a; IF FALSE THEN DROP TABLE t; END IF; SELECT v FROM t;
DECLARE v INT64 DEFAULT (SELECT MAX(v) FROM source_a); SELECT v FROM source_b;
CREATE TEMP TABLE _SESSION.t AS SELECT v FROM source_a; SELECT v FROM _SESSION.t;
